summary.oneLiner: Ashima Ltd is a diversified holding company with a real estate development division and an investment portfolio managed through its wholly owned PMS subsidiary, Ashima Capital Management.
summary.business: Ashima Limited operates through two primary divisions. The Real Estate Division is engaged in plotted development and premium high-rise residential apartment projects, currently executing 'Swan Lake' and 'The Sovereign'. The Investment Division's portfolio is managed by its wholly owned subsidiary, Ashima Capital Management Limited, a SEBI-registered Portfolio Management Services entity that follows a value-investment philosophy with a long-term perspective.

business_model.title: What they do

The Real Estate Division is engaged in plotted development and premium high-rise residential apartment projects, currently executing 'Swan Lake' and 'The Sovereign'. The Investment Division's portfolio is managed by its wholly owned subsidiary, Ashima Capital Management Limited, a SEBI-registered Portfolio Management Services entity that follows a value-investment philosophy with a long-term perspective.

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Focus on maintaining high standards of Corporate Governance to enhance shareholder value and protect stakeholder interests.
- The Company raised funds through private placement of Non-Convertible Debentures and exercised call options for partial/early redemption of outstanding NCDs. No dividend policy, buyback, or explicit reinvestment philosophy is stated.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The Company has two ongoing real estate projects: 'Swan Lake', a plotted development project, and 'The Sovereign', a premium high-rise residential apartment project. There has been consistent progress in project execution for both projects during the year. No new capex or expansion plans are disclosed.
